reports.title: ALLIANT ENERGY ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND 2027 GUIDANCE

lines: •Narrowed 2026 ongoing earnings guidance to $3.41 - $3.46 per share, the top half of the original guidance range
•Announced 2027 earnings guidance range of $3.63 - $3.73 per share and 2027 annual common stock dividend target of $2.25 per share
Based on results for the first nine months of 2026, ongoing earnings per share guidance was narrowed to $3.41 - $3.46.
Alliant Energy expects peak demand to increase by approximately 60% by 2031, an industry-leading growth rate.
The Company announced 2027 earnings guidance of $3.63 to $3.73 per share.
Alliant Energy is issuing 2027 consolidated ongoing EPS guidance of $3.63 - $3.73, which at the midpoint represents 8% growth over 2026 original consolidated ongoing EPS guidance midpoint.
